---- MODULE W4Od17m7p0t0 ----
EXTENDS FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Controllers, FREE
VARIABLES reg, phase, crashed

vars == <<reg, phase, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ reg \in Controllers \cup {FREE}
    /\ phase \in [Controllers -> {"idle","holding","using","crashed"}]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Controllers

Init ==
    /\ reg = FREE
    /\ phase = [c \in Controllers |-> "idle"]
    /\ crashed = {}

Acquire(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ phase[c] = "idle"
    /\ reg = FREE
    /\ reg' = c
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "holding"]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Enter(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ phase[c] = "holding"
    /\ reg = c
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "using"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, crashed>>

Release(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ phase[c] = "using"
    /\ reg = c
    /\ reg' = FREE
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Crash(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {c}
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "crashed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED reg

Recover(c) ==
    /\ c \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {c}
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ reg' = IF reg = c THEN FREE ELSE reg

Next == \E c \in Controllers : Acquire(c) \/ Enter(c) \/ Release(c) \/ Crash(c) \/ Recover(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ArmSingleDriver ==
    \A a, b \in Controllers :
        (phase[a] = "using" /\ phase[b] = "using") => a = b
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {c1, c2, c3}
    FREE = FREE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ArmSingleDriver
nl:
An airport baggage router directs suitcases onto a single motorized sorting arm that only one router controller may drive at a time. Controllers coordinate through a shared compare-and-swap register that names the current owner, or is free. A controller first performs a compare-and-swap that flips the register from free to its own id, which moves it into the holding state. Only after confirming the register still names it does the controller enter the using state and actually drive the arm. When finished it releases, clearing the register back to free and returning to idle. Any controller may crash silently at any moment, even while driving the arm; a crash freezes that controller and leaves whatever value it had written stranded in the register. A crashed controller can no longer enter the using state, so at most one controller is ever actively driving the arm. A crashed controller may later recover, returning to idle and clearing the register if its own stranded id was still parked there.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at no reachable state are two distinct controllers both in the using state driving the sorting arm simultaneously.

---- MODULE W4Od18m3p6t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes, MaxTerm, NONE
VARIABLES term, role, nodeTerm, forced

vars == <<term, role, nodeTerm, forced>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ role \in [Nodes -> {"follower","candidate","leader","down"}]
    /\ nodeTerm \in [Nodes -> 0..MaxTerm]
    /\ forced \in Nodes \cup {NONE}

Init ==
    /\ term = 0
    /\ role = [n \in Nodes |-> "follower"]
    /\ nodeTerm = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
    /\ forced = NONE

Demote(n) == [m \in Nodes |-> IF m = n THEN "candidate"
                              ELSE IF role[m] = "down" THEN "down" ELSE "follower"]

StartElection(n) ==
    /\ role[n] # "down"
    /\ term' = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE term
    /\ nodeTerm' = [nodeTerm EXCEPT ![n] = term']
    /\ role' = Demote(n)
    /\ forced' = NONE

Win(n) ==
    /\ role[n] = "candidate"
    /\ nodeTerm[n] = term
    /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![n] = "leader"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, nodeTerm, forced>>

Act(n) ==
    /\ role[n] = "leader"
    /\ nodeTerm[n] = term
    /\ (forced = NONE \/ forced = n)
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Fail(n) ==
    /\ role[n] = "leader"
    /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![n] = "down"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, nodeTerm, forced>>

AdminForce(n) ==
    /\ role[n] # "down"
    /\ term' = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE term
    /\ nodeTerm' = [nodeTerm EXCEPT ![n] = term']
    /\ role' = [m \in Nodes |-> IF m = n THEN "leader"
                                ELSE IF role[m] = "down" THEN "down" ELSE "follower"]
    /\ forced' = n

Recover(n) ==
    /\ role[n] = "down"
    /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![n] = "follower"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, nodeTerm, forced>>

Next == \E n \in Nodes :
            StartElection(n) \/ Win(n) \/ Act(n) \/ Fail(n) \/ AdminForce(n) \/ Recover(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleLeaderActs == \A n \in Nodes : role[n] = "leader" => nodeTerm[n] = term
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {n1, n2, n3}
    MaxTerm = 3
    NONE = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleLeaderActs
nl:
A smart-home door lock network elects one coordinator node that is allowed to reconfigure the locks, with automatic failover if the coordinator dies. Every node carries a term number, and the network tracks a single global term. A node starts an election by bumping the global term, adopting that term as its own, becoming a candidate, and demoting every other live node back to follower. A candidate whose term still matches the global term may win and become the leader. Only a node that is currently the leader at the current global term may perform a reconfiguration action. If the leader fails, it drops to a down state and a fresh election restores service. A privileged admin override can forcibly install any live node as leader at a brand-new term, demoting everyone else. Because every term bump demotes all previous leaders, no node from a superseded term can linger in the leader role.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every node that currently holds the leader role does so at the current global term, so no stale-term node can ever act as coordinator.

---- MODULE W4Od4m5p2t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Tanks, Sensors, Quorum, Fleet, NONE
VARIABLES tank, proposal, approvals

vars == <<tank, proposal, approvals>>

RECURSIVE SumOver(_)
SumOver(S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
              ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN tank[x] + SumOver(S \ {x})

TypeOK ==
    /\ tank \in [Tanks -> 0..Fleet]
    /\ proposal \in (Tanks \X Tanks) \cup {NONE}
    /\ approvals \subseteq Sensors

Init ==
    /\ tank = [x \in Tanks |-> IF x = (CHOOSE y \in Tanks : TRUE) THEN Fleet ELSE 0]
    /\ proposal = NONE
    /\ approvals = {}

Propose(f, t) ==
    /\ proposal = NONE
    /\ f # t
    /\ tank[f] > 0
    /\ proposal' = <<f, t>>
    /\ approvals' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED tank

Vote(s) ==
    /\ proposal # NONE
    /\ s \notin approvals
    /\ approvals' = approvals \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tank, proposal>>

Commit ==
    /\ proposal # NONE
    /\ Cardinality(approvals) >= Quorum
    /\ tank[proposal[1]] > 0
    /\ tank' = [tank EXCEPT ![proposal[1]] = @ - 1, ![proposal[2]] = @ + 1]
    /\ proposal' = NONE
    /\ approvals' = {}

Cancel ==
    /\ proposal # NONE
    /\ proposal' = NONE
    /\ approvals' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED tank

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Tanks, t \in Tanks : Propose(f, t)
    \/ \E s \in Sensors : Vote(s)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Cancel

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

FleetConserved == SumOver(Tanks) = Fleet
====

CONSTANTS
    Tanks = {t1, t2, t3}
    Sensors = {s1, s2, s3}
    Quorum = 2
    Fleet = 3
    NONE = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FleetConserved
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line moves a fixed fleet of cars among three staging tanks of the wash loop, and no car is ever created or destroyed. To move one car from a source tank to a destination tank, a controller first proposes the move, then a quorum of independent position sensors must vote to approve it. A move is proposed only when the source tank is non-empty and no other proposal is pending. Sensors cast approval votes one at a time until a quorum is reached. Once a quorum approves and the source is still non-empty, the move commits, decrementing the source tank and incrementing the destination tank by exactly one car. A sensor may be slow rather than failed, so a pending proposal can also be cancelled and retried later without ever moving a car. Because every commit transfers exactly one car and nothing else adds or removes cars, the total number of cars across all tanks stays constant.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the sum of cars over all three staging tanks always equals the fixed fleet size.

    Movers = {m1, m2}
    Total = 3
    FREE = FREE
INIT Init

INVARIANT PassengersConserved
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper balances a fixed number of waiting passengers across floor queues, and passengers are never spawned or lost during rebalancing. A mover thread that wants to shift one passenger between floors must first win a shared compare-and-swap register that names the current mover or reads free. Winning the register flips it from free to the mover's id and puts that mover in the locked phase. Only the mover named in the register may transfer exactly one passenger from a non-empty source floor to a destination floor. After transferring, the mover releases the register back to free and returns to idle. A mover may crash silently at any time, freezing it and stranding its id in the register; a crashed mover can later recover, clearing the register if its id was still parked there. Since each transfer moves one passenger and nothing else adds or removes passengers, the total passenger count is invariant.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the sum of waiting passengers across all floor queues always equals the fixed total passenger count.

    /\ fine = FREE
    /\ fine' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mw, coarse, crashed>>

    /\ fine = c
    /\ f # t
    /\ mw[f] > 0
    /\ mw' = [mw EXCEPT ![f] = @ - 1, ![t] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, crashed>>

    /\ coarse' = FREE
    /\ fine' = IF fine = c THEN FREE ELSE fine

    /\ UNCHANGED <<mw, coarse, fine>>

    Ctrls = {c1, c2}
    Pool = 3
    FREE = FREE
INIT Init

INVARIANT MegawattsConserved

A power-grid load shedder redistributes a fixed pool of megawatt blocks among substation buses without ever creating or destroying load. To move one megawatt block between buses a shedder controller must take a hierarchical lock: first the coarse region lock, then the fine per-operation lock. The coarse lock is granted only when free, and the fine lock only to a controller that already holds the coarse lock. A controller holding both locks may transfer exactly one megawatt block from a non-empty source bus to a destination bus. Releasing drops both locks back to free. A controller can crash silently while holding locks, stranding them, but may later recover and free any locks it still held. Because every transfer conserves the block it moves and no other action changes bus loads, the total megawatts across the grid is constant.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total megawatt blocks summed over all substation buses always equals the fixed grid pool size.

An elevator bank commits passenger rebalancing moves through a two-phase commit across its car participants, and passengers are conserved across every committed move. A coordinator proposes moving one passenger from a non-empty source floor to a destination floor, opening a voting round. Each car participant independently casts a yes vote; because vote messages can be reordered in flight, votes are tracked as an unordered set and their arrival order is irrelevant. When every participant has voted yes, the coordinator commits, transferring exactly one passenger from source to destination and closing the round. At any time before commit the coordinator may abort the round, discarding all collected votes and moving no passenger. No proposal may open while another round is already in progress. Because a commit is the only action that changes floor loads and it moves exactly one passenger, the total passenger count never changes.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the sum of passengers over all floors always equals the fixed total, across every reachable state of the commit protocol.

---- MODULE W4Od9m2p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Regions, Parts, Total, NONE
VARIABLES load, active, ballot

vars == <<load, active, ballot>>

RECURSIVE SumOver(_)
SumOver(S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
              ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN load[x] + SumOver(S \ {x})

TypeOK ==
    /\ load \in [Regions -> 0..Total]
    /\ active \in (Regions \X Regions) \cup {NONE}
    /\ ballot \in [Parts -> {"none","yes","no"}]

Init ==
    /\ load = [r \in Regions |-> IF r = (CHOOSE s \in Regions : TRUE) THEN Total ELSE 0]
    /\ active = NONE
    /\ ballot = [p \in Parts |-> "none"]

Open(f, t) ==
    /\ active = NONE
    /\ f # t
    /\ load[f] > 0
    /\ active' = <<f, t>>
    /\ ballot' = [p \in Parts |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED load

VoteYes(p) ==
    /\ active # NONE
    /\ ballot[p] = "none"
    /\ ballot' = [ballot EXCEPT ![p] = "yes"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, active>>

VoteNo(p) ==
    /\ active # NONE
    /\ ballot[p] = "none"
    /\ ballot' = [ballot EXCEPT ![p] = "no"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, active>>

Commit ==
    /\ active # NONE
    /\ \A p \in Parts : ballot[p] = "yes"
    /\ load[active[1]] > 0
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![active[1]] = @ - 1, ![active[2]] = @ + 1]
    /\ active' = NONE
    /\ ballot' = [p \in Parts |-> "none"]

Abort ==
    /\ active # NONE
    /\ \E p \in Parts : ballot[p] = "no"
    /\ active' = NONE
    /\ ballot' = [p \in Parts |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED load

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Regions, t \in Regions : Open(f, t)
    \/ \E p \in Parts : VoteYes(p) \/ VoteNo(p)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort

CONSTANTS
    Regions = {r1, r2, r3}
    Parts = {p1, p2}
    Total = 3
    NONE = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT GridLoadConserved
nl:
A power-grid load shedder commits megawatt reallocations through a two-phase commit across region participants, conserving total load. A coordinator opens a round proposing to move one megawatt block from a non-empty source region to a destination region. Each participant records its vote in a shared ballot map as either yes or no; because the network reorders messages, participants may fill their ballot entries in any order. The coordinator commits only when the ballot map shows every participant voting yes, moving exactly one megawatt block from source to destination and clearing the ballot. If any participant has voted no, the coordinator aborts the round, resetting all ballots and moving nothing. A new round can open only when no round is currently active. Since commit is the sole load-changing action and it transfers exactly one block, total grid load is preserved.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total megawatt blocks summed over all regions always equals the fixed grid total in every reachable protocol state.

---- MODULE W4Od3m2p5t1 ----
CONSTANTS Transfers, Banks
VARIABLES proposed, yes, settled, cancelled

vars == <<proposed, yes, settled, cancelled>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ proposed \subseteq Transfers
    /\ yes \in [Transfers -> SUBSET Banks]
    /\ settled \subseteq Transfers
    /\ cancelled \subseteq Transfers

Init ==
    /\ proposed = {}
    /\ yes = [i \in Transfers |-> {}]
    /\ settled = {}
    /\ cancelled = {}

Propose(i) ==
    /\ i \notin proposed
    /\ proposed' = proposed \cup {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<yes, settled, cancelled>>

Vote(i, b) ==
    /\ i \in proposed
    /\ i \notin settled
    /\ i \notin cancelled
    /\ b \notin yes[i]
    /\ yes' = [yes EXCEPT ![i] = @ \cup {b}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, settled, cancelled>>

Settle(i) ==
    /\ i \in proposed
    /\ yes[i] = Banks
    /\ i \notin settled
    /\ i \notin cancelled
    /\ settled' = settled \cup {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, yes, cancelled>>

Cancel(i) ==
    /\ i \in proposed
    /\ i \notin settled
    /\ i \notin cancelled
    /\ cancelled' = cancelled \cup {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, yes, settled>>

Terminating ==
    /\ \A i \in Transfers : i \in settled \/ i \in cancelled
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Transfers : Propose(i) \/ Settle(i) \/ Cancel(i)
    \/ \E i \in Transfers, b \in Banks : Vote(i, b)
    \/ Terminating

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SettleCancelDisjoint == settled \cap cancelled = {}
====
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch finalizes a set of transfers, and each transfer's irreversible settlement must happen at most once. A transfer first has its settlement round proposed, after which the participating banks vote to approve it. Because approval messages travel over a reordering network, each transfer's yes votes are tracked as an unordered set, so the order in which banks vote does not matter. A transfer settles only once its round is open, every bank has voted yes, and it has been neither settled nor cancelled before. Settlement is irreversible: a settled transfer can never be re-proposed, re-settled, or cancelled. Alternatively, an open transfer that has not yet settled may be cancelled, which is also terminal. Thus no transfer can ever end up both settled and cancelled, and none settles twice.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the set of settled transfers and the set of cancelled transfers are always disjoint.

---- MODULE W4Od3m2p5t2 ----
CONSTANTS Transfers, Banks, Engines, NONE
VARIABLES owner, yes, status, settledBy

vars == <<owner, yes, status, settledBy>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Transfers -> Engines \cup {NONE}]
    /\ yes \in [Transfers -> SUBSET Banks]
    /\ status \in [Transfers -> {"open","settled"}]
    /\ settledBy \in [Transfers -> Engines \cup {NONE}]

Init ==
    /\ owner = [i \in Transfers |-> NONE]
    /\ yes = [i \in Transfers |-> {}]
    /\ status = [i \in Transfers |-> "open"]
    /\ settledBy = [i \in Transfers |-> NONE]

Claim(e, i) ==
    /\ status[i] = "open"
    /\ owner[i] = NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![i] = e]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<yes, status, settledBy>>

Vote(e, i, b) ==
    /\ owner[i] = e
    /\ status[i] = "open"
    /\ b \notin yes[i]
    /\ yes' = [yes EXCEPT ![i] = @ \cup {b}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, status, settledBy>>

Settle(e, i) ==
    /\ owner[i] = e
    /\ status[i] = "open"
    /\ yes[i] = Banks
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![i] = "settled"]
    /\ settledBy' = [settledBy EXCEPT ![i] = e]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, yes>>

Release(e, i) ==
    /\ owner[i] = e
    /\ status[i] = "open"
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]
    /\ yes' = [yes EXCEPT ![i] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, settledBy>>

Terminating ==
    /\ \A i \in Transfers : status[i] = "settled"
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E e \in Engines, i \in Transfers :
            Claim(e, i) \/ Settle(e, i) \/ Release(e, i)
            \/ \E b \in Banks : Vote(e, i, b)
    \/ Terminating

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SettlementAttributed ==
    \A i \in Transfers :
        status[i] = "settled" => (settledBy[i] = owner[i] /\ owner[i] # NONE)
====
